question: The area of the triangle with vertices $(-1,0)$, $(3,0)$ and $(1,k)$ is $8$ square units. Using determinants, determine all possible values of $k$.
explanation:
Determinant form of the area
$$\frac{1}{2}\left|\begin{vmatrix}-1&0&1\\3&0&1\\1&k&1\end{vmatrix}\right|=8$$
Evaluation of the determinant
The determinant equals $$(-1)(-k)+[3k]=4k$$ Therefore, $$\frac{1}{2}|4k|=8$$
Modulus equation
Thus, $$2|k|=8$$ giving $$|k|=4$$
Possible values
Hence, $$k=4\quad\text{or}\quad k=-4$$
